placements.title: From ad-hoc handling to systematic pipeline design
placements.frame: What architectural decisions and constraints shape the system's pipeline behavior?

placements.title: Pipeline must self-generate identifiers when none are provided
placements.frame: How does the pipeline ensure every memory receives a committed identifier when the submitter supplies none?
placements.why: The segment carries a thematic requirement — the pipeline must produce a slug from memory content via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback and commit successfully — that future envelopes will keep feeding as pipeline ID-generation behavior is specified, tested, or revised. No existing leaf holds this theme.
